A two-step trade to get the {item:Obsidian Knife}, the knife used to skin creatures. {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops}, in Ab'Dendriel, turns a {item:Dragon Shield} into a {item:Piece of Draconian Steel}; then {npc:Uzgod}, in Kazordoon, combines the steel with an {item:Obsidian Lance} and forges the knife for you.
{wiki:The Sweaty Cyclops Quest|The Sweaty Cyclops Quest} completed (3 {item:Bast Skirt|Bast Skirts}); if you haven't done it yet, the cyclops asks you for them during this exchange.
only if you haven't done The Sweaty Cyclops Quest
Approximate cost: {item:Dragon Shield} + {item:Obsidian Lance} ≈ 4.5k (at Djinn prices). An {item:Obsidian Knife} is worth between 5k and 12k, depending on the server.
You can repeat the exchange as many times as you like, but you have to wait **20 hours** between each knife.

Get a {item:Dragon Shield} and an {item:Obsidian Lance}. Take a {item:Rope}, a {item:Scythe} and a {item:Shovel} and go to {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} in Ab'Dendriel (by boat: say {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes} to the captain in Thais, Carlin, Venore or Edron; you arrive at {npc:Captain Seagull}'s boat). The cyclops lives on the **4th floor of a tower** to the **north-east** of the depot: enter the small {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} cave beneath the **wheat field east of the depot**, cross it to the tower and climb to the top floor. To come back, take the same path in reverse: go down the tower, cross the cave and climb up to the wheat field.
A Sweaty Cyclops (4th floor of the tower)
On the way you may meet {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}.
Say {key:hi} and {key:uth'lokr} (the name of the metal, known to humans as Piece of Draconian Steel). Answer {key:yes}.
Doing the Bast Skirts favour (if needed)

If you haven't done {wiki:The Sweaty Cyclops Quest|The Sweaty Cyclops Quest} yet, the cyclops first asks you for a favour: answer {key:yes}, then say {key:bast skirt} and {key:yes} to hand over 3 {item:Bast Skirt|Bast Skirts}. If you have already done that quest, he won't ask for them again and you go straight to the next step.
Say {key:uth'lokr} again and {key:yes}. The cyclops keeps the {item:Dragon Shield} and gives you a {item:Piece of Draconian Steel}.

Go to Kazordoon and look for {npc:Uzgod}, beneath the {wiki:Depot|depot}. Take the {item:Piece of Draconian Steel} and the {item:Obsidian Lance} with you. Kazordoon is inside the mountain The Big Old One, **south** of Ab'Dendriel: walk to the mountain entrance (see {wiki:Route: Kazordoon|the way to the Kazordoon entrance}; take a {item:Rope} and a {item:Shovel}) or, with Premium, take the {wiki:Steamship} in Cormaya ({npc:Gurbasch}) or Farmine ({npc:Thorgrin}) by saying {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}. To leave, go back through the mountain entrance or take the Steamship from {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of the city.
In Kazordoon you can find {creature:Rat|Rats}, {creature:Bat|Bats} and {creature:Spider|Spiders}.
Say {key:hi}, {key:piece of draconian steel} (or {key:draconian steel}) and {key:yes}. Uzgod keeps the steel and the lance and gives you the {item:Obsidian Knife}.

You can exchange the {item:Piece of Draconian Steel} and the {item:Obsidian Lance} with Uzgod even if you haven't handed the 3 Bast Skirts to A Sweaty Cyclops (for example, if you bought the steel from another player).
Before update 9.83, the exchange could only be repeated every 24 hours; now it is every 20 hours.
